```{r library}

library(riskRegression)

library(prodlim)

```

```{r predictRisk.function}

predictRisk.function <- function(object, newdata, times, ...) {
  object(newdata = newdata, times = times, ...)
}
``
```

```{r function to get the CIF for 7 year}

tgrid <- seq(0, 7, by = 0.1)

get_cif_7y <- function(i, data, fit1, fit2, tgrid) {
  nd <- data[i, , drop = FALSE]
  
  nd_long <- nd[rep(1, length(tgrid)), ]
  nd_long$year <- tgrid
  rownames(nd_long) <- NULL
  
  # Get hazards directly
  h1 <- predict(fit1, newdata = nd_long, type = "hazard")
  h2 <- predict(fit2, newdata = nd_long, type = "hazard")
  
  # Total hazard
  htot <- h1 + h2
  
  # Time increments
  dt <- c(0, diff(tgrid))
  
  # Cumulative hazard
  Htot <- cumsum(htot * dt)
  
  # Survival
  S <- exp(-Htot)
  
  # Left-endpoint survival
  S_left <- c(1, S[-length(S)])
  
  # CIF for cause 1
  cif1 <- cumsum(S_left * h1 * dt)
  
  return(tail(cif1, 1))
}



```


```{r predict CIF(t) FOR A WHOLE DATASET for 7 year}

predict_cif_7y <- function(data, fit1, fit2, t = 7) {
  tgrid <- seq(0, t, by = 0.1)
  
  sapply(
    seq_len(nrow(data)),
    get_cif_7y,
    data  = data,
    fit1  = fit1,
    fit2  = fit2,
    tgrid = tgrid
  )
}




```


```{r 7-year t-AUC}

#---leave CamPalGN out----

data7.1<-data7%>%
  filter(clus!="CamPalGN")

data7.1v<-data7%>%
  filter(clus=="CamPalGN")

# fit_inst and fit_death fitted on training data (data7.1)

# Cause 1: Institutionalisation (cens == 1), treating death as censored
fit_inst.7.1 <- stpm2(
  Surv(year, ev1) ~ age10 + sex + mdsupdrs3.10 + hybl + mmsebltotal,
  data  = data7.1,
  df    = 1,        # df=1 with scale="odds" ≈ your k=0 flexsurvspline model
  scale = "odds"
)

# Cause 2: Death (cens == 2), treating institutionalisation as censored
fit_death.7.1 <- stpm2(
  Surv(year, ev2) ~ age10 + sex + mdsupdrs3.10 + hybl + mmsebltotal,
  data  = data7.1,
  df    = 1,
  scale = "odds"
)


# and get_cif_7y() is the function above


score_7y.1v <- Score(
  object = list("CIF model" = function(newdata, times, ...) {
    predict_cif_7y(
      data = newdata,
      fit1 = fit_inst.7.1,
      fit2 = fit_death.7.1,
      t    = times
    )
  }),
  formula = Hist(year, event) ~ 1,
  data    = data7.1v,
  cause   = 1,
  times   = 7,
  metrics = "AUC",
  conf.int = TRUE
)

score_7y.1v$AUC$score
```

```{r 7-year calibration}

#-----leave CamPalGN out----


tgrid <- seq(0, 7, by = 0.1)

data7.1v$pred7_cif <- sapply(
  seq_len(nrow(data7.1v)),
  get_cif_7y,
  data  = data7.1v,
  fit1  = fit_inst.7.1,   # models fitted on training data
  fit2  = fit_death.7.1,
  tgrid = tgrid
)


data7.1v <- data7.1v %>%
  mutate(risk_group = ntile(pred7_cif, 10))

# ── AJ estimator stratified by decile ────────────────────────────────────────
# risk_group must be a factor for prodlim to stratify correctly
aj_fit7.1 <- prodlim(Hist(year, event) ~ factor(risk_group), data = data7.1v)

obs_cif_raw7.1 <- summary(aj_fit7.1, times = 7, cause = 1)

# ── Extract the data frame from the summary object ───────────────────────────
# summary.prodlim returns a list, not a data frame — extract $table
obs_df7.1 <- as.data.frame(obs_cif_raw7.1) %>%
  select(risk_group, 
         obs_cif = cuminc,
         lower_ci = lower,
         upper_ci = upper)

# ── Mean predicted per decile ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
pred_df7.1 <- data7.1v %>%
  group_by(risk_group) %>%
  summarise(mean_pred = mean(pred7_cif), .groups = "drop")

calib_df7.1 <- left_join(pred_df7.1, obs_df7.1, by = "risk_group")

# ── Plot ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────


ggplot(calib_df7.1, aes(x = mean_pred, y = obs_cif)) +
  geom_abline(
    slope = 1, intercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50"
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = lower_ci, ymax = upper_ci),
    width = 0.015
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  coord_equal(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Mean predicted 7-year CIF",
    y = "Observed 7-year CIF (Aalen–Johansen)",
    title = "Calibration — CamPalGN validation cohort"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r predictRisk.function for 10 year}

predictRisk.function <- function(object, newdata, times, ...) {
  object(newdata = newdata, times = times, ...)
}
``

```


```{r function to get the CIF for 10 year}

tgrid <- seq(0, 10, by = 0.1)

get_cif_10y <- function(i, data, fit1, fit2, tgrid) {
  nd <- data[i, , drop = FALSE]
  
  nd_long <- nd[rep(1, length(tgrid)), ]
  nd_long$year <- tgrid
  rownames(nd_long) <- NULL
  
  # Get hazards directly
  h1 <- predict(fit1, newdata = nd_long, type = "hazard")
  h2 <- predict(fit2, newdata = nd_long, type = "hazard")
  
  # Total hazard
  htot <- h1 + h2
  
  # Time increments
  dt <- c(0, diff(tgrid))
  
  # Cumulative hazard
  Htot <- cumsum(htot * dt)
  
  # Survival
  S <- exp(-Htot)
  
  # Left-endpoint survival
  S_left <- c(1, S[-length(S)])
  
  # CIF for cause 1
  cif1 <- cumsum(S_left * h1 * dt)
  
  return(tail(cif1, 1))
}



```


```{r predict CIF(t) FOR A WHOLE DATASET for 10 years}

predict_cif_10y <- function(data, fit1, fit2, t = 10) {
  tgrid <- seq(0, t, by = 0.1)
  
  sapply(
    seq_len(nrow(data)),
    get_cif_10y,
    data  = data,
    fit1  = fit1,
    fit2  = fit2,
    tgrid = tgrid
  )
}


```

```{r 10-year AUC}
fit_death.10.5 <- stpm2(
  Surv(year, ev2) ~ age10 + sex + mdsupdrs3.10 + hybl + mmsebltotal,
  data  = data10.5,
  df    = 1,
  scale = "odds"
)

score_10y.5v <- Score(
  object = list("CIF model" = function(newdata, times, ...) {
    predict_cif_10y(
      data = newdata,
      fit1 = fit_inst.10.5,
      fit2 = fit_death.10.5,
      t    = times
    )
  }),
  formula = Hist(year, event) ~ 1,
  data    = data10.5v,
  cause   = 1,
  times   = 10,
  metrics = "AUC",
  conf.int = TRUE
)

score_10y.5v$AUC$score #0.74(0.68,0.81)


#---leave PINE out----

data10.6<-data10%>%
  filter(clus!="PINE")

data10.6v<-data10%>%
  filter(clus=="PINE")

# Cause 1: Institutionalisation (cens == 1), treating death as censored
fit_inst.10.6 <- stpm2(
  Surv(year, ev1) ~ age10 + sex + mdsupdrs3.10 + hybl + mmsebltotal,
  data  = data10.6,
  df    = 1,        # df=1 with scale="odds" ≈ your k=0 flexsurvspline model
  scale = "odds"
)

# Cause 2: Death (cens == 2), treating institutionalisation as censored
fit_death.10.6 <- stpm2(
  Surv(year, ev2) ~ age10 + sex + mdsupdrs3.10 + hybl + mmsebltotal,
  data  = data10.6,
  df    = 1,
  scale = "odds"
)

score_10y.6v <- Score(
  object = list("CIF model" = function(newdata, times, ...) {
    predict_cif_10y(
      data = newdata,
      fit1 = fit_inst.10.6,
      fit2 = fit_death.10.6,
      t    = times
    )
  }),
  formula = Hist(year, event) ~ 1,
  data    = data10.6v,
  cause   = 1,
  times   = 10,
  metrics = "AUC",
  conf.int = TRUE
)

score_10y.6v$AUC$score #0.64(0.56,0.71)
```

```{r calibration 10 years }

#-----leave CamPalGN out----


tgrid <- seq(0, 10, by = 0.1)

data10.1v$pred10_cif <- sapply(
  seq_len(nrow(data10.1v)),
  get_cif_10y,
  data  = data10.1v,
  fit1  = fit_inst.10.1,   # models fitted on training data
  fit2  = fit_death.10.1,
  tgrid = tgrid
)


data10.1v <- data10.1v %>%
  mutate(risk_group = ntile(pred10_cif, 10))

# ── AJ estimator stratified by decile ────────────────────────────────────────
# risk_group must be a factor for prodlim to stratify correctly
aj_fit10.1 <- prodlim(Hist(year, event) ~ factor(risk_group), data = data10.1v)

obs_cif_raw10.1 <- summary(aj_fit10.1, times = 10, cause = 1)

# ── Extract the data frame from the summary object ───────────────────────────
# summary.prodlim returns a list, not a data frame — extract $table
obs_df10.1 <- as.data.frame(obs_cif_raw10.1) %>%
  select(risk_group, 
         obs_cif = cuminc,
         lower_ci = lower,
         upper_ci = upper)

# ── Mean predicted per decile ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
pred_df10.1 <- data10.1v %>%
  group_by(risk_group) %>%
  summarise(mean_pred = mean(pred10_cif), .groups = "drop")

calib_df10.1 <- left_join(pred_df10.1, obs_df10.1, by = "risk_group")

# ── Plot ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────


ggplot(calib_df10.1, aes(x = mean_pred, y = obs_cif)) +
  geom_abline(
    slope = 1, intercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50"
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = lower_ci, ymax = upper_ci),
    width = 0.015
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  coord_equal(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Mean predicted 10-year CIF",
    y = "Observed 10-year CIF (Aalen–Johansen)",
    title = "Calibration — CamPalGN validation cohort"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```
